CustomField.description: Picklist (top, bottom) setting where the section divider renders relative to the section content. The formTemplatePageSection LWC uses it (showDividerTop/showDividerBottom) to place the c-form-section-theme divider above or below; default behavior places it at the bottom when not 'top'. For Field Set it is passed as divider-position into c-flow-form.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose whether the section divider appears above (top) or below (bottom) this section's content. Requires the section divider to be enabled on the Divider tab.
CustomField.label: Divider Position
